text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Gold City...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold City's gaze was fixed on
a crane game filled with plushies
designed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Only girls everyone has high hopes for
get to be modeled into Paka Petits, you know.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So... well, um.
Maybe there's none, though.
choice_data_list: Maybe they'll even have a Paka Petit of City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
“Want to take a quick peek anyway?
They actually look pretty well-made for plushies.”
choice_data_list: Then you should probably hold the real thing and see for yourself.
Then you should probably hold the real thing and see for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why are you pulling out your wallet?
Don't tell me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
